newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy introduces emergency measures over Albanians.
newsitem.headline: Italy introduces emergency measures over Albanians.

text.p: The Italian government said on Wednesday it had declared a state of emergency throughout the country in response to a mass influx of Albanian refugees.

The measure, which will allow the government to resort to emergency funding, was contained in a cabinet decree which also empowered the authorities to repatriate any Albanians deemed to be a threat to public order.
A government statement, issued after the cabinet met for two hours on the Albanian crisis, said the state of emergency would remain in force until June 30.

The decree confirmed that Italy would grant temporary refuge to Albanians who have fled the armed anarchy in their homeland in a flotilla of ancient and rusting boats. Some 10,000 have poured into southeastern Italian ports since March 13.
In the main port of Brindisi, military sources said Italy had already begun repatriating criminals and other undesirables identified among the Albanians.
They said two giant Italian army Chinook helicopters with paratrooper guards on board had begun an airlift which would take some 290 Albanians back to Tirana in the course of the day.
